 Businessman loses Rs 10 lakh to cyber fraudster
 City | Sumukh Kulkarni | Nov 3, 2026, 01:19 IST Save Comments Share Nagpur: A 65-year-old businessman from Ramdaspeth was duped of ₹9.8 lakh after a cyber fraudster posing as a bank official tricked him into opening a malicious link on the pretext of preparing his pension card.
 The complainant, Narendra Kane, owns a plastic manufacturing company in MIDC industrial area. As per the police complaint, the incident occurred on Oct 23 when Kane was at his workplace.
 Around 4pm, Kane received a call from an unidentified person. The caller claimed to be calling from a bank and told Kane that the bank was preparing his pension card. He further informed him that a link would be sent to his mobile phone to complete the process.
 Kane opened the link and submitted the details. Within minutes, two transactions of ₹4.9 lakh each were carried out from his account.
 MIDC police have registered a case under provisions of Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita and Information Technology Act.
